head: codex/5675-provider-adapter-routes-publish
title: [v0.91.8][WP-09][provider] Add Kimi and MiniMax hosted adapter routes
body:
Implements #5675 with Rust-native Kimi/Moonshot and MiniMax hosted provider routes, bounded chat-completion budgets, current MiniMax endpoint, typed billing-envelope classification, and focused adapter tests.

Opus exact-head review completed; all actionable findings were fixed and independently re-reviewed. Live approved-key probes reached both providers but were blocked by insufficient account balances; those failures are recorded as non-retryable billing outcomes.
